snippet.title: GLORY TO THE HEROES - Early Access | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Launching into Steam Early Access on October 9!

Wishlist now at
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239670/Glory_To_The_Heroes/

Learn more at
https://glorytotheheroes.com.ua

Join our Discord - https://discord.com/invite/zmzkh7rdH3

Telegram - https://t.me/gtth_official
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/deaftonegames
X - https://x.com/sacedevgames

Glory to the Heroes, set in the theatre of the Russian-Ukrainian War, is an immersive PvPvE mil-sim that provides a unique perspective on modern warfare by combining massive combined-arms combat with extensive elements of survival and immersion, with the action taking place in accurately recreated real-world locations of actual battles.

Email - office@deaftonegames.com
--------
Music - GreyZoneAudio
